start.text: International banking has a one-time {international_fee} company fee. The teller opens it. Overseas payouts remain foreign currency until you choose to convert.

choices.text: I will convert after each weekly payout.
I will keep foreign currency and choose when to convert.

auto.text: Enable automatic conversion in Finance. You get home cash sooner, but pay the 1.5% spread and accept that week's quote.

manual.text: Use Finance when you need home cash. Waiting can improve the rate or make it worse; it is not a guaranteed gain.
